description: This file defines the Screen entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_screen' database table. It includes properties representing screen attributes like id, name, action URL, module association, menu configuration, and permissions, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Entity class representing a screen in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, name, URL, associated module, menu configurator, and permissions, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_screen'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module object associated with this screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the Module object associated with this screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator string, if any.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of permissions associated with this screen.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the collection of permissions for this screen.
